notes: F-STD-011 / STD-6.5: min(-0.0, +0.0) MUST be -0.0 (Display "-0") and max(-0.0, +0.0) MUST be +0.0 (Display "0"). The two signed zeros have distinct Display output, so this case locks both halves of the rule; the implementation emits an explicit tie-break because f64::min/max lower to an LLVM intrinsic whose answer for that tie depends on the optimisation level.
